name: OBSBOT Center
author: Stefano Mainardi
description: Preview and control an OBSBOT Meet 2 from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Camera status and controls for OBSBOT Meet 2

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to synchronize controls with the camera while the panel is open.

schema.label: Hide when disconnected
schema.description: Hide the bar icon when no OBSBOT camera is connected.

schema.label: Enable live preview
schema.description: Start the live preview only while the panel is open. Disable it to keep the camera free for other applications.
